title: Exam Orientation and How to Study

header.html: Exam overview, objective map and answer technique (all objectives)
Know the exam format and the eight objective groups; know what is new in version 004; use a repeatable method to answer every question
the official Terraform Associate (004) exam page and exam content list

html:
1The exam at a glance

Item Fact
Exam HashiCorp Terraform Associate, version 004 (the Terraform Associate exam)
Format Multiple choice, online proctored
Time One hour
Language English
Terraform version tested Terraform 1.12, with HCP Terraform content
Credential Expires after two years
Price 70.50 US dollars plus taxes and fees; a free retake is not included
Prerequisites Basic terminal skills and an understanding of on-premises and cloud architecture

The number of questions and the passing score are not published on the pages read, so this course does not quote them. HashiCorp does not publish weights per objective.

Exam tip

. Version 004 replaced 003 in January 2026. If a practice question mentions old behavior (for example only taint and no -replace), think of Terraform 1.12.

2The eight objective groups

Group Objectives Topic
1 1a to 1c Infrastructure as Code with Terraform
2 2a to 2d Terraform fundamentals: providers and state
3 3a to 3g Core workflow: init, validate, plan, apply, destroy, fmt
4 4a to 4h Configuration: resources, data, variables, outputs, types, expressions, dependencies, custom conditions, sensitive data
5 5a to 5d Modules
6 6a to 6d State management: backends, locking, drift
7 7a to 7c Maintain infrastructure: import, state CLI, logging
8 8a to 8d HCP Terraform
Exam tip

. Group 4 has eight objectives, the most of any group. Configuration and the core workflow are where most questions live.

3What is new in version 004

New topic Where it is taught
4f depends_on and create_before_destroy lifecycle rules Module 8
4g Validate configuration with custom conditions Module 9
4h Ephemeral values and write-only arguments Module 10
8c Organize and use HCP Terraform workspaces and projects Module 16

4How to answer every question

  1. Read the last line to see what is asked: a command, a block, a file or a behavior.
  2. Find the objective group the question belongs to.
  3. Eliminate answers with the wrong command, the wrong block type or a cloud-specific detail (provider detail is not tested).
  4. Remember the safe default: plan before apply, state is sensitive, never edit state by hand, pin versions.
  5. Answer every question; there is no stated penalty for a wrong answer.
Exam tip

. The exam asks what a command or block does, not for long code. Learn each command in one sentence.

5A study plan

Phase Modules Goal
1 1 to 4 IaC, providers, state and the core workflow
2 5 to 10 Configuration language
3 11 to 12 Modules
4 13 to 15 State, drift, import and logging
5 16 HCP Terraform
6 17 Exam technique and final review

6Exam Q&A

6.1 Practice questions (choose the best answer)

S1A candidate asks which Terraform version the Terraform Associate (004) exam tests. What is the answer?

  • ATerraform 0.12, including only the Community edition
  • BTerraform 1.6, including only lab-based tasks
  • CTerraform 2.0, including a hands-on terminal
  • DTerraform 1.12, including HCP Terraform content
Show the answer

Answer: D. Version 004 tests Terraform 1.12 and includes HCP Terraform content.

S2How long is the Terraform Associate exam, and how is it delivered?

  • AThree hours, in a test center only
  • BOne hour, online proctored, multiple choice
  • CThirty minutes, as a take-home assignment at home
  • DTwo hours, as a hands-on lab
Show the answer

Answer: B. The exam lasts one hour, is multiple choice and is online proctored.

S3Which topic is new in version 004 compared with version 003?

  • AThe terraform init command
  • BEphemeral values and write-only arguments
  • CWriting a resource block
  • DThe local backend
Show the answer

Answer: B. Ephemeral values and write-only arguments are new, along with custom conditions, lifecycle rules in 4f and workspaces and projects in HCP Terraform.

S4A question mentions a detail that only applies to one cloud provider. How should a candidate treat it?

  • AAs the main focus of the exam objectives
  • BAs unnecessary detail, since provider specifics are not tested
  • CAs proof that the answer must be a module
  • DAs a reason to skip the question
Show the answer

Answer: B. Provider-specific knowledge is not necessary for the exam.

S5Which objective group has the most objectives?

  • AGroup 3, the core workflow
  • BGroup 6, state management
  • CGroup 4, Terraform configuration
  • DGroup 8, HCP Terraform
Show the answer

Answer: C. Group 4 has eight objectives, 4a to 4h.

S6What happens to the credential after it is earned?

  • AIt never expires
  • BIt expires after one year
  • CIt expires after five years
  • DIt expires after two years
Show the answer

Answer: D. The credential expires after two years.

6.2 Recall questions

R1How long is the exam?

Show the answer

One hour.

R2Which Terraform version is tested?

Show the answer

Terraform 1.12.

R3How many objective groups are there?

Show the answer

Eight.

R4Which group is about HCP Terraform?

Show the answer

Group 8.

R5How long is the credential valid?

Show the answer

Two years.

R6Is the question count published?

Show the answer

No.

7Quick Reference Card

Topic Key fact
Format one hour, multiple choice, online proctored, Terraform 1.12
Groups 1 IaC, 2 fundamentals, 3 workflow, 4 configuration, 5 modules, 6 state, 7 maintain, 8 HCP Terraform
New in 004 lifecycle rules, custom conditions, ephemeral values and write-only arguments, workspaces and projects
Method find the group, eliminate wrong commands, safe defaults
